messages: Maria Chen: Following yesterday's outage where the cloud CDN and our auth provider flapped, we need a concise follow-up thread: owners, timelines, and one-line acceptance criteria for each fix. No vague items. Ajay Patel: Added a simple action-board and seeded cards. Link: https://outboards.internal/rw/vendor-failover (read/write to eng/ops). I'll keep the list lean. Priya Nair: I'll own the CDN retry/backoff tuning. Goal: reduce client-side retries that amplified load during vendor 503s. Deliverable: PR with config + perf regression test by 2026-04-08. Acceptance: 25% reduction in 5xx cascade during simulated 503 window. Kenji Sato: I'll take auth fallback automation: health-probe -> switch registry reads to local read-only replica -> alert if replica lag > 5s. Target: 2026-04-06. I'll add a dry-run plan. Samir Gupta: For tracking, please include the SLO/SLI we expect post-change. Example: registry-read-latency P95 < 200ms when fallback active. Kenji Sato: Will add SLI entries. Also adding a tiny script for failure injection:for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer BAD" https://model-registry.internal/api/v1/models; sleep 0.1; done Elaine Park: I'll update the vendor escalation matrix (who to call, C-level contacts, and contract remedies) and add the vendor-SLA summary to the shared drive. ETA: 2026-04-07. Maria Chen: Two meta items: 1) mark anything that requires design/arch time as "project"; 2) incident actions should be shippable in <2 weeks if possible. Ajay Patel: Question: do we want an automated circuit-breaker that trips on auth-provider 5xx rate and routes reads to a replica? If yes, I'll prototype a toggle. Priya Nair: I prefer a toggle first (manual enable from oncall) + one-click automation as follow-up. Minimizes risk from a buggy auto-router. ops-bot: :robot_face: Task created: "auth-fallback-toggle" assigned to eng-infra. ETA: 3 business days. Ticket: INF-4899. Samir Gupta: I'll synthesize recurring patterns — my note so far: vendor-side maintenance windows with inadequate grace responses (5xx vs 2xx+retry-after), token rotations causing transient 401s, and no cached read-path for model metadata. Put one bullet into the tracker card by EOD. Kenji Sato: Adding a runbook step: if registry auth fails > 3 consecutive mins, verify token provider status, then enable read-only replica, escalate to ops if replication lag > 5s. Maria Chen: Good. Also add a postmortem follow-up checkpoint on the calendar in 30 days to verify metrics and SLA trends after fixes. incident-bot: Follow-up checkpoint created: 2026-05-06. Invite sent. Ajay Patel: I'll open a runbook PR for the fallback steps and include a checklist: pre-deploy smoke, traffic cutover plan, rollback criteria. PR target: 2026-04-06. Elaine Park: Will schedule a vendor-health review next quarter and propose contract language for better retry behavior and advance maintenance notices. Priya Nair: I can run the first dry-run of CDN backoff config in the staging window next Wed. Need someone to watch prod telemetry. Samir Gupta: I'll watch telemetry and own escalation during the dry-run. Maria Chen: Final: everyone put a single-line owner/due/acceptance in the tracker card now. I'll close this thread after the follow-up meeting and collate into the incident tracker. Thanks. :thumbsup:
